integrity: The three-student theorem is a complete finite classification. An embedded standard-library verifier independently enumerates all 216 labeled profiles and the 36 school-relabeling classes, tries every unilateral strict-ranking deviation, and cross-checks two Boston implementations.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is restricted to complete strict preferences, unit capacities, a single common strict school priority, and at most three students; no larger-market formula is claimed.
title: Sharp three-student manipulation boundary for Boston under a common priority
